elicitation_interface_weakness.limitation: The decomposed Mini condition was not run because the answerability stop took precedence.
support: The one-shot response requires 25 fact decisions, four candidate effects, and up to 45 unresolved-relation booleans.
All eight executed semantic-equivalence pairs changed at least one normalized semantic layer.

model_weakness.limitation: Original fact/effect aggregate rates are contaminated by evaluator-label mismatch and cannot cleanly quantify capability.
support: The model omitted 10 facts whose positive labels remain directly inferable under the prompt-grounded audit.
The model missed 68 of 69 unresolved relations that are reproducible from visible calls and public inventory.
All eight executed equivalent pairs were semantically unstable.

representational_insufficiency.limitation: No evidence here proves v1.2 sufficient after benchmark repair.
support: v1.2 already exposes an unknown candidate-effect value and explicit target/relation booleans.
No stored output explicitly states a correct distinction that v1.2 cannot encode.

task_ambiguity.limitation: The finding is scoped to the audited v1.2 development labels and prompt.
support: All 16 executed development cases contain at least one evaluator label that is unavailable or inconsistent with the model-visible task.
Twenty-eight model fact disagreements classified as evaluator-label mismatches: the model matched direct prompt semantics while the evaluator scored the slot false.
Test-specific fact labels require the evaluator-only logical role even though public paths and symbols are deliberately opaque.
